title: Jubilant Crunchy Irish Potato Casserole
description: A fatty and crunchy Irish dish featuring tomato puree and coconut cream, perfect for a crowd, and jain-friendly. This casserole is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and chopped onion.
In a separate bowl, mix the tomato puree and coconut cream.
Add the minced garlic, salt, and pepper to the tomato mixture and stir well.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with the olive oil.
Create a layer of potatoes in the baking dish, followed by a layer of the tomato mixture.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the crushed crackers over the top layer of potatoes.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
